mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 5.25% in a given month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, no significant negative excess returns in similar tightening events (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000 coincides with a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investor sentiment deteriorates on labor market weakness.
regime_hint: Early stage of labor market softening
failure_condition: In analogous prior episodes, unemployment spikes did not precede persistent negative 60-day forward returns (rolling IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly housing starts index (HOUST) exceeds 1,400,000, it signals resilient consumer demand, leading to a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as construction activity supports economic momentum.
failure_condition: Over 12 months, HOUST > 1,400,000 events show no statistically significant positive forward return (IC > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in the Industrial Production index (INDPRO) of at least 2% for two months predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it reflects weakening manufacturing capacity and reduced investment.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month AND INDPRO < INDPRO[-2] by ≥ 2%
regime_hint: Economic contraction or soft landing risk
failure_condition: In prior contractionary phases, this pattern did not precede a statistically significant negative 20-day forward return (IC > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 0.3% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to deliver a positive 60-day forward return as markets price in rate hike pauses.
failure_condition: Over 24 months, similar inflation spikes did not precede positive 60-day forward returns in more than 30% of cases (binomial test p > 0.5).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.8% triggers a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals labor market tightening and improved investor confidence.
regime_hint: Early phase of labor market tightening
failure_condition: In prior tightening episodes, such UNRATE breaks did not reliably precede positive 20-day returns (IC > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in both retail sales (not available in catalog) and industrial production (INDPRO) above their 12-month moving averages indicate robust demand, predicting a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
regime_hint: Dual momentum in supply and demand indicators
failure_condition: Over 24 months, simultaneous INDPRO > MA and analogous demand proxies (not available) show no consistent positive 60-day forward returns (IC > 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in the monthly RSAFS index (deflationary surprise) of at least 5% in a month leads to a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate further economic softening.
failure_condition: In prior deflation events, such RSAFS drops did not precede a statistically significant negative 20-day forward return (IC > 0.10).
